review_scope: Read-only provider-free audit of the V7 bounded-diagnosis delta over V6.
required_claim_boundary: V7 can support only an exploratory claim about efficacy under a diagnosis budget limited to six turns per condition. It cannot be presented as general, independent, confirmatory, or unconditional efficacy evidence.
methodological_caveats: The six-turn budget was selected after observing V6 ceiling and is disclosed outcome-aware adaptation.
A short symmetric budget may amplify the value of diagnostic feedback; that is the declared estimand, not a neutral general efficacy test.
Evaluation remains conditional on the bounded baseline calibration gate.
reviewer: independent Hermes subagent, read-only provider-free audit
